title: Max et le poisson rouge
summary_en: Max the grey cat discovers a goldfish named Bulle in a bowl. He watches it and tries to touch it, until Emma arrives.

sentences.fr: Max est un chat gris.
sentences.en: Max is a grey cat.

sentences.fr: Il a de grands yeux verts.
sentences.en: He has big green eyes.

sentences.fr: Il habite avec Emma dans un petit appartement.
sentences.en: He lives with Emma in a small flat.

sentences.fr: Le chat est seul dans la cuisine.
sentences.en: The cat is alone in the kitchen.

sentences.fr: Aujourd'hui, il y a un bol sur la table.
sentences.en: Today, there is a bowl on the table.

sentences.fr: Dans le bol, il y a un petit poisson rouge.
sentences.en: In the bowl, there is a small goldfish.

sentences.fr: Le poisson s'appelle Bulle.
sentences.en: The fish is called Bulle.

sentences.fr: Max saute vite sur la table.
sentences.en: Max quickly jumps onto the table.

sentences.fr: Le chat regarde le poisson rouge.
sentences.en: The cat looks at the goldfish.

sentences.fr: Le poisson rouge nage dans l'eau.
sentences.en: The goldfish swims in the water.

sentences.fr: Max ne bouge pas.
sentences.en: Max does not move.

sentences.fr: Max regarde l'eau et le poisson.
sentences.en: Max watches the water and the fish.

sentences.fr: Il regarde Bulle très longtemps.
sentences.en: He watches Bulle for a very long time.

sentences.fr: Bulle regarde Max aussi.
sentences.en: Bulle looks at Max too.

pic.alt: Max sits on the table and stares at Bulle the goldfish in her bowl.

sentences.fr: Max veut toucher le poisson.
sentences.en: Max wants to touch the fish.

sentences.fr: Il veut jouer avec le poisson.
sentences.en: He wants to play with the fish.

sentences.fr: Il touche l'eau du bol avec sa patte.
sentences.en: He touches the water in the bowl with his paw.

sentences.fr: L'eau est froide !
sentences.en: The water is cold!

sentences.fr: Max retire vite sa patte.
sentences.en: Max quickly pulls back his paw.

sentences.fr: Sa petite patte est mouillée.
sentences.en: His little paw is wet.

sentences.fr: Bulle nage vite, nage et nage encore.
sentences.en: Bulle swims fast, and swims and swims again.

sentences.fr: Max veut encore toucher le petit poisson.
sentences.en: Max still wants to touch the little fish.

pic.alt: Max puts his paw into the cold water and Bulle swims away.

sentences.fr: Emma arrive dans la cuisine.
sentences.en: Emma comes into the kitchen.

sentences.fr: « Max ! Non ! » dit-elle.
sentences.en: “Max! No!” she says.

sentences.fr: Max est mouillé et il a l'air triste.
sentences.en: Max is wet and he looks sad.

sentences.fr: Emma rit : « Pauvre petit chat ! »
sentences.en: Emma laughs: “Poor little cat!”

sentences.fr: « Le poisson n'est pas un jouet. »
sentences.en: “The fish is not a toy.”

sentences.fr: Elle prend Max dans ses bras.
sentences.en: She takes Max in her arms.

sentences.fr: Max regarde Bulle, et Bulle regarde Max.
sentences.en: Max looks at Bulle, and Bulle looks at Max.

sentences.fr: Ils sont peut-être amis.
sentences.en: Maybe they are friends.
